Description

Bookings that finish after 16:00 must be made at least 72 hours in advance. Any bookings made with less than 72 hours notice will be cancelled (with no refund) as the park attendant will not be available.

Looking to hire a 5-a-side football pitch in North West London? Kilburn Grange has the perfect facilities for lovers of the small-sided version of the beautiful game. 5-a-side football at Kilburn Grange is played on hard (macadam). So whether you're looking for a casual kick about with your friends or whether you're part of a team that is a cohesive 5-a-side football machine, Kilburn Grange is the right choice for you.

If public transport isn't your thing, then parking facilities are available where a pay and display system is operated. The specific prices may vary depending on the time of day, so if you'd like to know this information then please contact the venue.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Kilburn Grange? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends. It also takes the hassle out of paying before each game and collecting money from teammates as there is a one-time payment.

The closest station when travelling is West Hampstead. The facility is located a short walk from here - for more details on how to access the facility please contact the venue.
